extension.name: Identifier
extension.dc:title: Alternative Identifiers
extension.dc:subject: dwc:Taxon dwc:Event dwc:Occurrence
extension.dc:description: An alternative identifier for a taxon, event, or occurrence. Version 2026-11-27 adds identifierType, identifierTypeIRI, identifierTypeSource, and identifierLanguage.

property.name: identifier
property.dc:description: An unambiguous reference to a resource within a given context.
property.comments: Recommended best practice is to identify a resource by means of a string conforming to a formal identification system.

property.name: identifierType
property.dc:description: A category or system that best matches the nature of an identifier.
property.comments: Recommended best practice is to use a controlled vocabulary.

property.name: identifierTypeIRI
property.dc:description: An IRI of a controlled vocabulary value for a type of identifier.
property.comments: Recommended best practice is to use an IRI for a term in a controlled vocabulary.

property.name: identifierTypeSource
property.dc:description: A reference to a controlled vocabulary in which the definition of a value in identifierType is given.

property.name: identifierLanguage
property.dc:description: A language in which an identifier is presented.
property.comments: Recommended best practice is to use an ISO639-2 three-letter language code.

property.name: title
property.dc:description: An optional display label for the URL that the publisher may prefer be displayed with the identifier or link

property.name: format
property.dc:description: mime type of content returned by identifier in case the identifier is resolvable. Plain UUIDs for example do not have a dc:format return type, as they are not resolvable on their own. For a list of MIME types see the list maintained by IANA: http://www.iana.org/assignments/media-types/index.html, in particular the text http://www.iana.org/assignments/media-types/text/ and application http://www.iana.org/assignments/media-types/application/ types. Frequently used values are text/html, text/xml, application/rdf+xml, application/json

property.name: datasetID
property.dc:description: An identifier for a subset of data.
